sentences.en: In British English, they use 'full stop' instead of 'period'.
sentences.zh: 在英式英语中，他们使用“句号”而不是“逗号”。

sentences.en: Don't forget to put a full stop at the end of each sentence.
sentences.zh: 不要忘了在每个句子的末尾加上一个句号。

sentences.en: She ended her letter with three full stops instead of one.
sentences.zh: 她在信件结尾处用了三个句号而不是一个。
